title: Must, Ought To, and Because
label: ch:ml-must-ought-to-and-because
canDo: I can say what I must, ought to and need not do, and give a reason for an action or a plan with -atukoṇṭŭ or kāraṇaṁ.

payoff.summary: Complete ML-R342-advice-and-reasons: must, ought to and need not, reasons with -atukoṇṭŭ and kāraṇaṁ, a plan with its reason, and the new letter ഔ.
